liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Iko Iko** (1 review): Lively Iko Iko; hard-charging Watchtower; climaxing The Other One [17]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): Fire On The Mountain lacks urgency; Looks Like Rain bores; He's Gone lacks purpose [17]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-11-15.senn441.flair.24535.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 138 min; rated 4/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd1987-11-15.sbd.fix.uh_clem.27307.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 135 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd87-11-15.sbd.nawrocki.4750.sbefail.shnf**: pre-FM broadcast master; 19 songs; 135 min; rated 4.42/5 by 12 [4]. Said about its sound: Good quality sound; band was obviously on that night; Iko Iko blazing along; super quality sound; Steaming Watchtower; super quality sound [13][14]
- **gd87-11-15.sennheiser.french.17185.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 19 songs; 137 min; rated 3.25/5 by 8 [7]. Said about its sound: The Other One and Morning Dew are unlistenable due to severe audio damage; ORTF technique uses two cardioid microphones spaced 17cm, angled 110 degrees [8][15]

## Around the show

- First audience with Garcia since his 1986 coma; strong singing, synthed guitar sound [9]
- Rated alongside September 18, 1987 as the best concert of that year [12]
- Long Beach performance considered the best Watchtower ever played there [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-11-15.senn441.flair.24535.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Jason Flair; source: Sennheiser441>tcd5m>cas(1st Gen Copy Made On Matching Calibrated Dragons metal master,metal copy) [1]. Also: Plugged in after West L.A. Fadeaway; flipped after Cassidy; edited by Jason Flair [1]
- **gd1987-11-15.sbd.fix.uh_clem.27307.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by uh_clem; source: This source is a fixed version of Doug Nawrocki's seed (etree shnid=4750). [2]. Also: Uhclem fixed Drumz/Space transition, sector errors, and DC offset; compressed to FLAC [2]
- **gd87-11-15.sbd.nawrocki.4750.sbefail.shnf**: source: SBD > MC > Sonic Solutions > Pre-FM Dat @44.1 [4]
- **gd87-11-15.sennheiser.french.17185.sbeok.shnf**: source: Digital Ambient recording by M. French 20th row near center (Phil's side) Sennheiser MKE 2002 (HRTF, worn in/on hat) > WM-D6C (dolby C)analog>CD via hardware… [7]. Also: Taper uses Sennheiser MKE 2002 mics; no plans to remaster cuts on disc 2; CD via hardware transfer from CD master using EAC [16][18]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1987-11-15 Sun Long Beach Arena, Long Beach, CA](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1428020096193/grateful-dead-1987-11-15-sun-long-beach) [24]
- Fan art by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1987-11-15 Sun Long Beach Arena, Long Beach, CA](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1428020096193/grateful-dead-1987-11-15-sun-long-beach) [25]
